violations.why: measure3 (prio 6) preempts measure1 between using numberOfRecords as the index and incrementing it, so the increment loses an update and the record slot is wrong.
measure3 changes numberOfRecords between the index read and the read in the increment.
measure1 (prio 5) preempts communicate (prio 3) after it reads numberOfRecords. The later reset to 0 is based on a stale value.
measure3 preempts communicate between the read and the reset, so the check on the value is stale.
measure3 preempts measure2 between the write of 0 and the check, so the check can see a nonzero value.
communicate (prio 3) preempts measure2 (prio 2) between the write and the read-back of tickCounter.
